title: WhyNoIPv6 — Beyond AAAA (DNSSEC, PTR, SMTP)
description: The informational dimensions collected on every scan but not shown on the site: DNSSEC validation, reverse DNS, and whether mail actually answers over IPv6.

panels.title: DNSSEC adoption
panels.description: Domains with a validating DNSSEC chain, of those where the check produced a verdict. Informational only — never gates classification.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE dnssec_observed = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE dnssec_observed IN ('supported', 'unsupported')), 0) AS share FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: PTR coverage (v6 hosts)
panels.description: Domains whose apex AAAA addresses have reverse DNS. partial (some addresses) counts as covered.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE ptr_observed IN ('supported', 'partial'))::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE ptr_observed IN ('supported', 'partial', 'unsupported')), 0) AS share FROM domain WHERE base_status = 'supported' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: SMTP answers over v6
panels.description: Of domains whose MX publishes AAAA, how many mail servers actually complete an SMTP handshake over IPv6.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE smtp_observed = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE smtp_observed IN ('supported', 'unsupported')), 0) AS share FROM domain WHERE mx_status = 'supported' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Paper-v6 mail
panels.description: MX publishes AAAA but SMTP does not answer over IPv6 — mail that looks v6-ready on paper and is not.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS paper FROM domain WHERE mx_status = 'supported' AND smtp_observed = 'unsupported' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: DNSSEC by tier
panels.description: Validating-chain share within each classification. Do IPv6 heroes also do DNSSEC, or are the hygiene populations disjoint?

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'hero' AND dnssec_observed = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'hero' AND dnssec_observed IN ('supported', 'unsupported')), 0) AS hero, count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'partial' AND dnssec_observed = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'partial' AND dnssec_observed IN ('supported', 'unsupported')), 0) AS partial, count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'sinner' AND dnssec_observed = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'sinner' AND dnssec_observed IN ('supported', 'unsupported')), 0) AS sinner FROM domain WHERE NOT disabled

panels.title: SMTP over IPv6 (MX with AAAA)
panels.description: Handshake outcomes for mail servers that advertise AAAA on their MX hosts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE smtp_observed = 'supported') AS answers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE smtp_observed = 'unsupported') AS refuses, count(*) FILTER (WHERE smtp_observed NOT IN ('supported', 'unsupported') OR smtp_observed IS NULL) AS untested FROM domain WHERE mx_status = 'supported' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: PTR verdicts (v6-enabled apexes)
panels.description: Reverse-DNS state of apex AAAA addresses: full, partial (some addresses), or none.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE ptr_observed = 'supported') AS full, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ptr_observed = 'partial') AS partial, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ptr_observed = 'unsupported') AS none FROM domain WHERE base_status = 'supported' AND NOT disabled

panels.title: Hygiene trends (share of scans per day)
panels.description: Daily supported-share of each informational check across all scans that produced a verdict. Scans the raw hypertable — keep the range modest.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '1d') AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE dnssec = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE dnssec IN ('supported', 'unsupported')), 0) AS dnssec, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ptr IN ('supported', 'partial'))::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE ptr IN ('supported', 'partial', 'unsupported')), 0) AS ptr, count(*) FILTER (WHERE smtp = 'supported')::float / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE smtp IN ('supported', 'unsupported')), 0) AS smtp FROM scan WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
